groups.title: iCarly cast
groups.def: The five main cast characters of iCarly.

groups.title: iCarly's recurring adults
groups.def: Recurring adult characters on iCarly (not main cast, not one of the recurring kids).

groups.title: Victorious cast
groups.def: The main cast characters of Victorious, including Robbie's puppet Rex.

groups.title: Victorious's recurring adults
groups.def: Recurring adult characters on Victorious.

groups.title: Hollywood Arts students
groups.def: Characters actually enrolled as students at Hollywood Arts High School. Rex is Robbie's puppet, not independently enrolled.

groups.title: Drake & Josh cast
groups.def: The five main cast characters of Drake & Josh.

groups.title: Drake & Josh's recurring adults
groups.def: Recurring adult characters on Drake & Josh.

groups.title: Zoey 101 cast
groups.def: The main cast characters of Zoey 101 across its run.

groups.title: Zoey 101's recurring characters
groups.def: Recurring (not main cast) characters on Zoey 101.

groups.title: Big Time Rush cast
groups.def: The main cast characters of Big Time Rush.

groups.title: BTR's recurring characters
groups.def: Recurring (not main cast) characters on Big Time Rush.

groups.title: Big Time Rush (the band)
groups.def: The four teenagers who make up the boy band Big Time Rush, as opposed to their family, friends, or the adults at the label.

groups.title: Teachers
groups.def: Characters who teach a class at a school somewhere in this pool.

groups.title: School staff (non-teaching)
groups.def: Adults who work at a school in this pool in a non-teaching role: principal, counselor, dean, or dorm advisor.

groups.title: Siblings
groups.def: Has a brother or sister (including step-siblings) who is also a character in this pool.

groups.title: Played by the same actor twice
groups.def: Portrayed by an actor who plays a different character elsewhere in this file: Miranda Cosgrove (Megan Parker & Carly Shay), Victoria Justice (Lola Martinez & Tori Vega), Jerry Trainor (Crazy Steve & Spencer Shay).

groups.title: Younger than the teen leads
groups.def: A kid character, younger than the shows' teenage leads, regardless of which show.

groups.title: Recurring teens
groups.def: A teenage character tagged recurring rather than main cast, regardless of which show.

groups.title: Main cast, but not teens
groups.def: Tagged as main cast on their own show despite not being one of the teenage leads (an adult or a kid).

groups.title: Parent of a teen lead
groups.def: A character in this pool who is the parent or step-parent of one of the shows' teenage leads.
